evidence_gaps: Fresh sanitised runtime forensics within two hours, including configuration provenance and chain/mode labels.
Per-trade realised gross proceeds, notional, fees, slippage, price impact, gas/priority fees, builder payments, token taxes, Solana rent/ATA effects and failed-attempt costs.
Receipt-level correlation from signal through quote, simulation, submission, confirmation, balance reconciliation and exit.
Terminal failure taxonomy separating STRATEGY/MARKET loss from EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failure, including failure phase and incurred cost.
Out-of-sample delayed executable exit outcomes for every strategy-chain pair, including no-fill and unsellable cases.
Money-weighted net P&L, profit factor, drawdown, tail loss and capital-time exposure by strategy, chain, asset, route and market regime.
Quote-to-fill deterioration, latency distribution, revert/failure rate, retry cost and emergency-unwind outcomes separately for Solana and EVM.
Independent validation that net P&L reconciles to wallet and receipt cash flows without unexplained residuals.
Sufficient non-overlapping observations across volatile, illiquid and high-fee regimes before any promotion decision.

proposals.downside_risk: More conservative accounting may reduce eligible samples and requires careful native-to-reporting-currency valuation.

evidence.detail: Windows record fees and slippage, but net_profit may be supplied directly; price impact, gas/priority fees, failed-attempt costs, rent, approvals and builder payments are not first-class validated fields.
EVM feature adaptation models gas, builder fees, slippage, price impact and latency reserve, but these components are not preserved consistently in Strategy Lab outcome accounting.
Solana execution captures wallet balance deltas, enabling actual priority/base fee and cash-movement reconciliation when runtime evidence is available.

proposals.expected_effect: Prevents overstated net edge and makes strategy degradation distinguishable from routing, RPC, simulation and settlement failures.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 100 closed counterfactual outcomes per chain across at least 20 independent daily windows, with complete cost fields and zero unexplained reconciliation breaches.
proposals.rationale: Promotion decisions should use a reproducible money-weighted identity whose cost components differ by chain. Solana needs base/priority fees, ATA/rent treatment, quote impact, failed transaction fees and unwind costs; EVM needs swap gas, approvals, EIP-1559 priority/base fees, builder payments, taxes and reverted-attempt gas. Independently classify negative market outcomes as STRATEGY/MARKET and unsuccessful or degraded execution as EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE.
proposals.shadow_test: For every SHADOW outcome, recompute net P&L from immutable gross proceeds minus itemised chain-specific costs and compare with recorded net. Stop and mark accounting invalid if any unexplained residual exceeds 1 basis point of notional, any required cost is missing, or failure costs are assigned to market loss.
proposals.strategy: Strategy Lab evaluation and all registered strategy families

proposals.downside_risk: Sparse markets may require long observation periods; counterfactual fills can still be optimistic unless latency and failure models are calibrated from runtime receipts.

evidence.detail: The executor explicitly states quote simulations are not promotion evidence.
quote_simulated_net_base is derived from notional multiplied by signal expected_net_edge_bps rather than an independently observed future exit.
Common executable gates require positive net bps, liquidity, sellability and quote freshness, but do not establish realised persistence after entry latency and exit execution.

proposals.expected_effect: Measures adverse selection, edge decay, exit sellability and money-weighted net expectancy without forcing trades.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 200 eligible signals and 100 independently closed outcomes per strategy-chain pair over at least 30 days and multiple volatility/gas regimes; fewer observations permit only continued SHADOW status.
proposals.rationale: Contemporaneous executable quotes test entry feasibility, not durable strategy edge. Each signal needs delayed, non-overlapping, out-of-sample entry and exit marks using executable size, actual route constraints and chain-specific failure/cost assumptions.
proposals.shadow_test: Capture an executable entry quote, then obtain executable exit quotes at predefined horizons without hindsight. Deduct Solana priority/base fees, rent effects and failure/unwind costs; deduct EVM gas, approvals, priority fees, builder costs, token taxes and revert costs. Reject a family if out-of-sample net P&L is non-positive, profit factor is at most 1, tail loss exceeds its risk budget, or quote-to-outcome attrition exceeds the preset failure ceiling.
proposals.strategy: Cross Venue Net Arbitrage, Liquidity Confirmed Momentum, Dislocation Mean Reversion, Flow Acceleration and other SHADOW families

proposals.downside_risk: Taxonomy mistakes and duplicate retries could distort counts unless events have stable correlation identifiers.

evidence.detail: The event-processing path catches broad exceptions and continues, making quote, RPC, simulation, balance, transaction and persistence failures invisible to strategy scorecards.
Only an aggregate execution_failures count is recorded; failure phase, chain cost and retry outcome are not represented.
Solana platform metrics use realised_net_sol from closed positions, but absence of explicit failure attribution prevents separating skipped/failed execution from market performance.

proposals.expected_effect: Produces actionable failure rates and prevents replacing strategies for infrastructure defects or overlooking costly execution defects.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 500 evaluated opportunities per chain, including at least 30 naturally occurring or safely injected non-signing failure cases in each major failure phase.
proposals.rationale: A strategy that identified positive executable edge but failed because of RPC, stale blockhash, nonce, allowance, simulation, rate limit or settlement issues must not be diagnosed as a market-loss strategy. Conversely, successful execution followed by adverse price movement belongs to STRATEGY/MARKET.
proposals.shadow_test: Replay or observe signals with a stable opportunity ID and classify every terminal result as NO_EDGE, STRATEGY_MARKET_LOSS, EXECUTION_FAILURE or INFRASTRUCTURE_FAILURE, recording attempted costs. Stop if any eligible signal lacks one terminal classification, classifications double-count, or reconciliation against execution receipts differs by more than 1%.

rejected_ideas.idea: Promote any strategy because simulated net P&L or profit factor is positive.
rejected_ideas.reason: The repository explicitly marks quote simulations as non-promotion evidence, and no fresh realised runtime outcomes are supplied.

rejected_ideas.idea: Increase trade frequency or relax liquidity, sellability, simulation or positive-edge gates.
rejected_ideas.reason: Inactivity without executable edge is preferable to forced negative-expectancy trades.

rejected_ideas.idea: Optimise leader selection or lifecycle decisions by win rate.
rejected_ideas.reason: Win rate is not money-weighted and can hide large losses and chain-specific execution costs.

rejected_ideas.idea: Treat all unsuccessful opportunities as strategy losses.
rejected_ideas.reason: RPC, routing, simulation, signing, fee-market and settlement defects are EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failures and require separate attribution.

summary: Architecture-only review completed. The repository generally fails closed, separates SHADOW from signing, and evaluates money-weighted results rather than raw win count. However, current Strategy Lab accounting can accept externally supplied net P&L without independently itemising every chain-specific cost, SHADOW quote results lack delayed realised counterfactual outcomes, and some EVM SiBot exceptions are silently discarded. These gaps can confound STRATEGY/MARKET loss with EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failure. No profitability, CANARY-readiness, or LIVE-readiness conclusion is supported without fresh runtime forensics.
